layout.arrangement: Title bar spans the top in a blue-bordered box with a yellow slide-number circle at the far right. Below, the left half contains two side-by-side vertical columns of airplane illustrations (Positive Class on the left, Negative Class on the right). The right half contains three stacked rectangular panels: Activation Function (top), Training (middle), and Evaluation (bottom).

regions.name: Title Bar
regions.content: Blue-bordered white box containing the title text; yellow circle with slide number 3 sits at the right end.

regions.name: Positive Class Panel
regions.content: Red-themed vertical panel with header 'Positive Class', subtitle '"Shoot the Enemy"', five airplane sketches (some with skull markings), a 'Label' tag, and five '+1' labels stacked vertically.

regions.name: Negative Class Panel
regions.content: Green-themed vertical panel with header 'Negative Class', subtitle '"Safe"', five airplane sketches (all safe/regular), a 'Label' tag, and five '-1' labels stacked vertically.

regions.name: Activation Function Panel
regions.content: Purple-bordered box with header 'Activation Function', text 'Bi-polor step (-1, +1)' and 'Threshold at "zero"', and a small step-function plot.

regions.name: Training Panel
regions.content: Gray-bordered box with header 'Training' and a left-to-right flowchart: Input Sample → Model → Predicted Class → LOSS → Label of Input Sample, with mapping annotations under Model and Label nodes.

regions.name: Evaluation Panel
regions.content: Gray-bordered box with header 'Evaluation' and a left-to-right flowchart: Test Sample → Model → Predicted Class, with mapping annotations under Model and Predicted Class nodes.

layout.hierarchy: The title is the largest text. Section headers (Positive Class, Negative Class, Activation Function, Training, Evaluation) are bold and color-coded, dominating their local regions. Airplane illustrations and flowchart nodes are secondary visual anchors. Small annotation text (+1, -1, mappings) is tertiary.

visual_elements.description: Two columns of hand-drawn-style airplane illustrations. Left column (Positive Class) has 5 planes; several display skull-and-crossbones markings indicating enemies. Right column (Negative Class) has 5 planes; all appear as regular/safe aircraft. Each column has a narrow label strip to its right showing repeated +1 or -1 values.

Small step-function plot inside the Activation Function box. Y-axis shows -1 (bottom) and +1 (top); X-axis shows 0 at the origin. The curve is a horizontal line at -1 for x<0 and jumps to +1 at x=0, remaining flat for x>0.

Training flowchart with five nodes connected by right-pointing arrows: 'Input Sample' → 'Model' (with sub-caption '(Any value) → (-1, +1)') → 'Predicted Class' → 'LOSS' → 'Label of Input Sample' (with sub-caption '(+1, -1)').
Evaluation flowchart with three nodes connected by right-pointing arrows: 'Test Sample' → 'Model' (with sub-caption '(Any value) → (-1, +1)') → 'Predicted Class' (with sub-caption '(+1, -1)').

imagery: Ten simple line-art airplane illustrations arranged in two vertical columns; enemy planes in the positive column are marked with small skull symbols.
A small Cartesian step-function graph in the Activation Function panel.
typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold and larger than all other text. Section headers are bold and color-matched to their panels (red, green, purple, dark gray). Subtitles '"Shoot the Enemy"' and '"Safe"' are in quotes. Node labels in flowcharts are centered and small. Annotation captions under Model and output nodes are smaller and parenthesized.
animation_state: Static slide; no partial builds or reveal states are visible.
recreation_brief:
1. Create a white-background slide. Add a title text box at the top spanning most of the width with a blue border: 'Training Samples with Labels [-1,+1] (Two Classes)' in bold black text. Place a small yellow circle at the top-right containing the number '3'.
2. On the left half, draw two tall adjacent panels. Left panel: red header bar reading 'Positive Class', subtitle '"Shoot the Enemy"' beneath it, five simple airplane icons stacked vertically (add small skull icons to 2–3 of them), a narrow vertical strip labeled 'Label', and five '+1' labels aligned with each plane. Right panel: green header bar reading 'Negative Class', subtitle '"Safe"', five plain airplane icons, a 'Label' strip, and five '-1' labels.
3. On the right half, stack three boxes. Top box: purple header 'Activation Function'; body text 'Bi-polor step (-1, +1)' and 'Threshold at "zero"'; insert a small chart showing a step function jumping from -1 to +1 at x=0.
4. Middle box: gray header 'Training'; build a horizontal flowchart with five white boxes and arrows: Input Sample → Model (caption below: '(Any value) → (-1, +1)') → Predicted Class → LOSS → Label of Input Sample (caption below: '(+1, -1)'). Color the Model box orange-red.
5. Bottom box: gray header 'Evaluation'; build a horizontal flowchart with three white boxes and arrows: Test Sample → Model (caption below: '(Any value) → (-1, +1)') → Predicted Class (caption below: '(+1, -1)'). Color the Model box orange-red.
6. Ensure all text is transcribed exactly as specified, preserving the typo 'Bi-polor', the spacing in '[-1,+1]', and the quotation marks around "Shoot the Enemy", "Safe", and "zero".
